visualCharacteristics.purpose: Responsive grid of content cards, each with an optional image and a body of heading, text and link
visualCharacteristics.layout: 1 column on mobile, 2 from 600px, 3 from 900px; sets of 4/8 cards use 2 columns from 900px and 4 from 1200px. Overlay tiles extend to the content edges (8px gap, 32px from 900px). Cards have no border or background.
behavior: Each authored row becomes one card (`ul > li` with `.cards-card-image` and `.cards-card-body`).

Cards are classified by content: body with only a heading -> `.cards-card-overlay` (square image tile with the heading link as a white label, whole tile clickable); heading + optional price (paragraph with strikethrough) + CTA -> `.cards-card-deal` (296/366 image, outline pill CTA); heading + description -> `.cards-card-feature` (image at its authored ratio, text-link CTA with arrow).
The CTA style follows authoring emphasis when present (bold = primary pink pill, italic = secondary outline); otherwise it defaults by card type.
The block gets `.cards-layout-{type}` when all cards share a type, and `.cards-cols-4` for 4/8/... cards.
Same-origin raster images are re-rendered as optimized pictures (750px width).

contentPattern.structure: image cell (picture) + body cell (heading, paragraphs, optional link); a single cell holding image and text also works

variants.links: Block holds only links to site pages; cards are built from query-index.json (image, title, description) instead of authored rows.
variants.bento: Rows are authored as in the default; the first card is featured (wider, rust background), the first paragraph of each card is styled as a tag, and text-only cards span double width on large screens.

usage: Use for any set of repeating items such as deal, destination, port, ship, offer or service cards. Author one row per card.
reuseGuidance: Default cards cover image + title + price/description + CTA. The block has no carousel behaviour: carousel content renders as a grid. For an image tile with an overlaid label, author only a heading (with link) in the body. Bold the CTA link for a primary pink button.
